block.miso_tts.workflow: Generate complete English speech files locally. Prepare the model and authorized tokenizer first; Run never downloads weights.
block.miso_tts.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.miso_tts.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.miso_tts.invalid_config: Check the Miso TTS settings and limits.
block.miso_tts.model.title: Miso TTS
block.miso_tts.model.description: Generate complete English speech files with the local pinned Miso TTS model and an explicit interrupt input.
block.miso_tts.help_asset_directory: Prepare 33.2 GB of pinned assets and the authorized Llama tokenizer. No automatic download during Run.
block.miso_tts.help_environment_python: Dedicated Miso environment. Empty uses the application interpreter. This trusted executable runs locally; nothing is installed automatically.
block.miso_tts.help_watermark_key_ref: Store a private JSON array of five integers (0–255) in the wallet. Enter only its reference here, never the key.
block.miso_tts.help_output_directory: Empty uses this node’s persistent audio directory. Unique names; no overwrites or automatic deletion.
block.miso_tts.help_device: CUDA is recommended for interactive use. CPU is explicit and slow; unavailable CUDA never silently falls back.
block.miso_tts.help_format: Ogg/Opus or PCM WAV. File output only, not an audio stream. Speech is English, with no reference-voice cloning.
block.miso_tts.help_temperature: Official model sampling control. Higher values increase variation; not a voice identity selector.
block.miso_tts.help_topk: Number of candidate audio tokens retained by the official sampler.
block.miso_tts.help_precision: Bfloat16 reduces steady-state model memory. Loading has a larger float32 peak; budget RAM separately.
block.miso_tts.help_threads: Bound native CPU parallelism in the owned inference process.
block.miso_tts.help_max_audio_sec: A generation reaching the limit without EOS is refused, not published as complete. Shorter limits may cut off long text.
block.miso_tts.help_max_text_chars: Reject oversized text. The model also enforces its own combined text/audio token window.
block.miso_tts.help_timeout_sec: Includes verification, model loading, synthesis, encoding and publication.
block.miso_tts.help_memory_limit_mib: Linux virtual address-space ceiling, not a RAM reservation or VRAM guarantee.
block.miso_tts.help_min_available_ram_mi: Refuse loading below this threshold. Default 64 GiB accounts for loading peaks; reduce only after measuring an appropriate host.
block.miso_tts.help_max_pending: Active Runtime only. Zero rejects new text while busy. Interrupt cancels the current job and clears earlier pending requests.
